arxiv-2012-00698.title: Data-driven Optimal Control of a SEIR model for COVID-19
arxiv-2012-00698.creator: Hailiang Liu and Xuping Tian
arxiv-2012-00698.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Hailiang Liu and Xuping Tian. We present a data-driven optimal control approach which integrates the reported partial data with the epidemic dynamics for COVID-19. We use a basic Susceptible-Exposed-Infectious-Recovered (SEIR) model, the model parameters are time-varying and learned from the data. This approach serves to forecast the evolution of the outbreak over a relatively short time period and provide scheduled controls of the epidemic. We provide efficient numerical algorithms based on a generalized Pontryagin Maximum Principle associated with the optimal control theory.

arxiv-2103-06754.description: Abstract We searched for shocked carbon chain chemistry (SCCC) sources with C 3 S abundances surpassing those of HC 5 N towards the dark cloud L1251, using the Effelsberg telescope at K-band (18 – 26 GHz). L1251-1 and L1251-3 are identified as the most promising SCCC sources. The two sources harbor young stellar objects.

arxiv-2204-10836.title: Federated Learning Enables Big Data for Rare Cancer Boundary Detection
arxiv-2204-10836.creator: Sarthak Pati and Ujjwal Baid and Brandon Edwards and Micah Sheller and Shih-Han Wang and G Anthony Reina and Patrick Foley and Alexey Gruzdev and Deepthi Karkada and Christos Davatzikos and Chiharu Sako and Satyam Ghodasara and Michel Bilello and Suyash Mohan and Philipp Vollmuth and Gianluca Brugna
arxiv-2204-10836.description: Abstract Although machine learning (ML) has shown promise in numerous domains, there are concerns about generalizability to out-of-sample data. This is currently addressed by centrally sharing ample, and importantly diverse, data from multiple sites. However, such centralization is challenging to scale (or even not feasible) due to various limitations.

arxiv-2402-10454.title: Optimizing Skin Lesion Classification via Multimodal Data and Auxiliary Task Integration
arxiv-2402-10454.creator: Mahapara Khurshid, Mayank Vatsa, Richa Singh
arxiv-2402-10454.description: Abstract The rising global prevalence of skin conditions, some of which can escalate to life-threatening stages if not timely diagnosed and treated, presents a significant healthcare challenge. This issue is particularly acute in remote areas where limited access to healthcare often results in delayed treatment, allowing skin diseases to advance to more critical stages.

arxiv-2404-06756.title: CrimeAlarm: Towards Intensive Intent Dynamics in Fine-grained Crime Prediction
arxiv-2404-06756.creator: Kaixi Hu, Lin Li✉, Qing Xie, Xiaohui Tao, Guandong Xu
arxiv-2404-06756.description: Abstract Granularity and accuracy are two crucial factors for crime event prediction. Within fine-grained event classification, multiple criminal intents may alternately exhibit in preceding sequential events, and progress differently in next. Such intensive intent dynamics makes training models hard to capture unobserved intents, and thus leads to sub-optimal generalization performance, especially in the intertwining of numerous potential events.

arxiv-2504-00427.title: Wavenumber affects the lift of ray-inspired fins near a substrate
arxiv-2504-00427.creator: Yuanhang Zhu 1,2,∗, Leo Liu 1, Tianjun Han 1,3, Qimin Feng 4, Keith Moored 3, Qiang Zhong 4, and Daniel Quinn 1,5,∗
arxiv-2504-00427.description: Abstract Rays and skates tend to have different fin kinematics depending on their proximity to a ground plane such as the sea floor. Near the ground, rays tend to be more undulatory (high wavenumber), while far from the ground, rays tend to be more oscillatory (low wavenumber).

arxiv-2504-05914.title: High-Resource Translation: Turning Abundance into Accessibility
arxiv-2504-05914.creator: Yanampally Abhiram Reddy 1
arxiv-2504-05914.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel approach to constructing an English-to-Telugu translation model by leveraging transfer learning techniques and addressing the challenges associated with low-resource languages. Utilizing the Bharat Parallel Corpus Collection (BPCC) as the primary dataset, the model incorporates iterative backtranslation to generate synthetic parallel data, effectively augmenting the training dataset and enhancing the model’s translation capabilities.

arxiv-2504-19973.title: Stringy KLT Relations on A ​ d ​ S AdS
arxiv-2504-19973.creator: Luis F. Alday, Maria Nocchi and, Aurélie Strömholm Sangaré
arxiv-2504-19973.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Luis F. Alday, Maria Nocchi and, Aurélie Strömholm Sangaré. We study the building blocks of open and closed string amplitudes on A ​ d ​ S AdS . These are given by two infinite towers of world-sheet integrals generalising the Euler and complex beta functions respectively. We show that the open and closed building blocks are related by an A ​ d ​ S AdS version of the KLT relations, whose Kernel can be computed exactly.

arxiv-2505-11648.title: Joint Graph Estimation and Signal Restoration for Robust Federated Learning
arxiv-2505-11648.description: Abstract We propose a robust aggregation method for model parameters in federated learning (FL) under noisy communications. FL is a distributed machine learning paradigm in which a central server aggregates local model parameters from multiple clients. These parameters are often noisy and/or have missing values during data collection, training, and communication between the clients and server.

arxiv-2506-07749.title: Controllability of induced bilinear systems on the sphere
arxiv-2506-07749.creator: Marco A. Colque-Choquecallata 1 , Efrain Cruz-Mullisaca 1 , Victor H. Patty-Yujra 1
arxiv-2506-07749.description: Abstract 1 Instituto de investigación Matemática, Universidad Mayor de San Andrés, Bolivia Abstract In this paper, we investigate the controllability of bilinear control systems of the form \dot{s}=As+uBs , where s\in\mathbb{S}^{2} and A,B\in gl(3,\mathbb{R}) are skew-symmetric matrices. First, we prove that the algebraic condition [A,B]\neq 0 ensures that the Lie algebra rank condition is satisfied for these systems.

arxiv-2512-07399.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pascal Auscher, Sebastian Bechtel, Luca Haardt. We introduce and study a new scale of function spaces that characterize the homogeneous Besov spaces B ˙ p , q β \dot{\mathrm{B}}^{\beta}_{p,q} , hence completing earlier work by Ullrich. These new spaces include the ones introduced by Barton and Mayboroda, and systematically studied by Amenta under the name of weighted Z \mathrm{Z} -spaces, for the purpose of boundary value problems with B ˙ p , p β \dot{\mathrm{B}}^{\beta}_{p,p} data.

britannica-1911-mendoza-diego-hurtado-de.title: Mendoza, Diego Hurtado de (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-mendoza-diego-hurtado-de.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-mendoza-diego-hurtado-de.description: Article 'Mendoza, Diego Hurtado de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. novelist, poet, diplomatist and historian, a younger son of the count of Tendillas, governor of Granada, was born in that city in 1503. The celebrated marquis of Santillana was his great-grandfather. On leaving the university of Salamanca, Mendoza abandoned his intention of taking orders, served under Charles V. in Italy, and attended lectures at the universities of Bologna, Padua and Rome.

pmc-10569046.title: Free-Energy Landscape and Rate Estimation of the Aromatic Ring Flips in Basic Pancreatic Trypsin Inhibitors Using Metadynamics
pmc-10569046.creator: Mandar Kulkarni, Pär Söderhjelm
pmc-10569046.description: Aromatic side chains (phenylalanine and tyrosine) of a protein flip by 180° around the Cβ–Cγ axis (χ2 dihedral of the side chain), producing two symmetry-equivalent states. The study of ring flip dynamics with nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) experiments helps to understand local conformational fluctuations.

pmc-11644098.title: Synergistic Effect of Biochar, Phosphate Fertilizer, and Phosphorous Solubilizing Bacteria for Mitigating Cadmium (Cd) Stress and Improving Maize Growth in Cd-Contaminated Soil
pmc-11644098.creator: Wenjun Ma, Panjun Luo, Sarfraz Ahmed, Hafiz Saqib Hayat, Shakeel Ahmad Anjum, Lili Nian, Jun Wu, Yuzhen Wei, Wenxue Ba, Fasih Ullah Haider, Liqun Cai
pmc-11644098.description: Cadmium (Cd) contamination threatens human health and plant growth due to its accumulation in edible parts. The sole application of phosphorus-solubilizing bacteria (PSB), biochar (BC), and phosphorus (P) effectively mitigates Cd’s adverse effects in contaminated agricultural systems. However, further investigation into their combined impacts on Cd toxicity and maize (Zea mays) production is essential.

pmc-11675476.title: Optimizing Nurse Rostering: A Case Study Using Integer Programming to Enhance Operational Efficiency and Care Quality
pmc-11675476.creator: Aristeidis Mystakidis, Christos Koukaras, Paraskevas Koukaras, Konstantinos Kaparis, Stavros G Stavrinides, Christos Tjortjis, Clara Benna
pmc-11675476.description: Background/Objectives: This study addresses the complex challenge of Nurse Rostering (NR) in oncology departments, a critical component of healthcare management affecting operational efficiency and patient care quality. Given the intricate dynamics of healthcare settings, particularly in oncology clinics, where patient needs are acute and unpredictable, optimizing nurse schedules is paramount for enhancing care delivery and staff satisfaction.

pmc-12577340.title: Effect of early rescue ICSI in multiple cycles of couples with successful fertilization in the initial cycle of conventional IVF
pmc-12577340.creator: Mingzhao Li, Wennan Chen, Xia Xue, Juanzi Shi
pmc-12577340.description: BackgroundTotal fertilization failure (TFF) or near TFF may lead to cycle cancellation, which is a highly frustrating experience for patients, especially those who have undergone multiple attempts. Early rescue intracytoplasmic sperm injection (R-ICSI) has been shown to yield promising clinical results.

pmc-12609829.title: Impact of Diverse Dietary Patterns on Cognitive Health: Cumulative Evidence from Prospective Cohort Studies
pmc-12609829.creator: Youngyo Kim, Minkyung Je, Kyeonghoon Kang, Yoona Kim
pmc-12609829.description: Background/Objectives: The aging population is associated with an increased incidence of dementia, which deteriorates the quality of life of adults, leading to an elevated socioeconomic burden. This review aimed to extensively examine which dietary patterns favorably influence cognitive outcomes based on prospective cohort studies of adults.

pmc-12618690.title: Evaluating machine learning approaches for multiple attack classification with improved computational efficiency in IoT networks
pmc-12618690.creator: Maher Alharby
pmc-12618690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The rapid expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) devices has introduced significant security challenges, making IoT networks increasingly vulnerable to cyber-attacks. This research study develops and evaluates a comprehensive approach for detecting and classifying Denial of Service, Distributed Denial of Service, and Mirai attacks in IoT environments using five supervised machine learning algorithms: Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and K-Nearest Neighbors, applied to the CICIoT2023 dataset.

pmc-13461738.title: Exploring the link between IgE-mediated inflammation and cardiorenal function in adults living with and without HIV
pmc-13461738.creator: Phinnoty Mwansa, David Chisompola, Stella P Mainga, Joreen P Povia, Sepiso K Masenga
pmc-13461738.description: BackgroundImmunoglobulin E (IgE) is traditionally recognized for its role in allergic response. However, emerging evidence suggests it may also influence cardiovascular, renal, and immune function. Understanding how IgE relates to endothelial function, electrolytes, renal markers, inflammatory mediators, and sociodemographic factors could provide insight into integrated cardiorenal-immune pathways and inform risk stratification people living with or without HIV.
